name: rick-morty-mf
description: Rick and Morty Explorer con microfrontends (Module Federation)

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd mf-shell && npm install && cd ../mf-characters && npm install && cd ../mf-character-detail && npm install
scripts.start: concurrently -n shell,characters,detail -c blue,green,magenta "npm start --prefix mf-shell" "npm start --prefix mf-characters" "npm start --prefix mf-character-detail"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix mf-shell && npm test --prefix mf-characters && npm test --prefix mf-character-detail
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix mf-characters && npm run build --prefix mf-character-detail && npm run build --prefix mf-shell
